row.proto: bool Check(void *comp, uint8_t *team_key, uint16_t slot, char flag)
row.notes: myteam-g2: Finds team entry (comp[0x97], stride 0x30, field +0xc != -1 = has contract), then compares a driver's value (+0x18) against calendar-derived min/max (Career_Calc_CalendarEntryStartMinutes via comp[0x9d]+0x2d8+0x290, /1440 = days) and a driver hash map (comp[0xd2..]); returns whether the driver fits. Read-only filter for AutoContracts / retirement.
